events_log:
Game started. Round 1.
Dawn of Day 1:
Detective failed to identify the Mafia.
Doctor successfully saved Player_3.
discussion_log:
--- Discussion Round 1 ---
Player_6: *softly, with a thoughtful tone* "I feel like Player_3 must be relieved after being saved last night. That was close. But... I can't help but notice Player_2 seems a bit quiet. Maybe they're trying to keep a low profile? How are you feeling about all this, Player_2?"
Player_1: *calmly, with a measured tone* "I think Player_6 raises an interesting point. Player_2 has been quieter than usual, and that can sometimes signal hesitation or hiding something. But I also wonder—how did the Doctor know to save Player_3? Could there be more to that choice? It might be worth hearing from Player_3 too."
Player_4: *grinning and leaning back casually* "Well, well, sounds like Player_2's got a case of the 'silent treatment'—classic Mafia move, or just a terrible Wi-Fi connection? Hard to tell these days. And Player_3 being saved—what a lucky duck! But you know, they say when you dodge death, it makes you quack suspiciously louder. So, Player_3, any new life perspectives after your brush with danger?"
Player_5: *leans forward confidently, a calculating look in my eyes* "Interesting points all around. Player_3 being saved does make me curious—were they a target because someone knows something about them? Or was it just a random choice? As for Player_2, quiet doesn't always mean guilty, but it does make me wonder. Player_6 is quick to push that narrative, though. Could be an attempt to deflect attention... What do you think, Player_6? Why focus on Player_2 so early?"
Player_3: *eyes darting nervously* "Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold up—why is everyone so fascinated with me being saved? Are we really saying the Doctor just magically knew I was in danger? Or does someone here know more than they’re letting on? *Looks around suspiciously* Could the Mafia have slipped up, targeting me because I’m onto something? And Player_2, why so quiet? Guilt eating you alive, or just a strategy to seem harmless? I mean, how can we trust anyone here?!"
Player_2: *snaps back sharply* "Alright, everyone, calm down! First off, Player_6, you're fishing way too hard by calling me out for being quiet—I've been observing, not hiding. That’s strategy, not guilt. Second, Player_3, you’ve got a lot of nervous energy for someone who just got saved. Care to explain why you think the Mafia targeted you? Got something you’re hiding? And Player_1, you’re real curious about the Doctor’s choice—maybe because you know more than you should? Spill it, all of you!"
